impact: `_run_worker` is 90 lines and combines request-file creation, subprocess invocation, result decoding, schema validation, geometry/check validation, timing validation, and on-disk PDF verification. Adding a worker payload field requires modifying transport and validation logic interleaved in one function. I read the full function and grepped generation and attestation callers; no result-decoding helper isolates the protocol.
